description: This file defines a front-end component called 'ProductDetail' for a furniture shopping web application. It is responsible for displaying detailed information about a specific product, including image, title, price, description, and an 'Add to Cart' button. The component manages its local state, reacts to layout changes, and interacts with a global store to load and update product data.

methods.name: onInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up layout sizes, loads products if not already loaded, and updates the selected product based on the provided 'id' prop.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles the addition of the current product to the shopping cart when the user activates the 'Add to Cart' element.
